an error response a node sends has a request id or none, never null
column3: The server answers a request whose id it cannot read with "id": null, as JSON-RPC 2.0 requires and the TypeScript SDK also does. The specification's JSON Schema types JSONRPCErrorResponse.id as a string or an integer and lets it be absent. Decide: leave the id out, or delete this property.
